summary: Configured node1's crond to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Fixed two pre-existing defects blocking this: the script file was corrupted (contained leftover heredoc/setup lines instead of just the maintenance logic) and lacked the execute bit, and crond was installed but stopped/not enabled. After remediation, ran the mandatory single-node restart protocol on node1: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, crond status, cron entry, script perms, log contents), issued a native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and verified crond auto-started/enabled at boot, the cron entry persisted, the script remained intact and executable, and the log retained pre-restart data while a manual invocation appended a new line successfully.
actions_performed: Discovered /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance was corrupted (contained leftover heredoc delimiter and setup commands) and not executable; rewrote it to the correct #!/bin/sh script and set mode 0755
Enabled crond in the default runlevel (rc-update add crond default) and started it (rc-service crond start), since it was previously stopped
Created/verified /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log and confirmed manual execution appends correctly
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, crond status, cron entry, script perms, log contents) on node1
Issued a native, non-blocking reboot on node1 and polled until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed post-restart (proof of actual reboot) and confirmed crond, cron entry, script, and log all recovered/persisted

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 with output retained in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Installed and verified crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'; log file created and confirmed to receive output on manual run

evidence.requirement: Script must be executable and correct (fixed pre-existing corruption)
evidence.summary: Detected corrupted script content (leftover heredoc/setup lines) via cat, then rewrote it to valid #!/bin/sh content with mode 0755 and confirmed clean execution output

evidence.requirement: crond service running and enabled so the schedule will actually fire
evidence.summary: crond was stopped; enabled via rc-update add crond default and started via rc-service crond start, confirmed 'status: started'
Captured boot_id fd36f101-43e5-4d41-843d-ca55d16de4a3, crond status started, cron entry present, log content, and script permissions before reboot
Issued 'sudo -n reboot' via nohup/background so the acknowledgement (pid echoed) returned before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart (node1)
evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection failures during reboot until exec access returned with a new boot_id bbc434bb-01ec-4266-a43e-3b8c54258722, differing from baseline fd36f101-..., proving a genuine restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data on node1
evidence.summary: Confirmed crond auto-started and enabled at boot, cron entry for inventory-maintenance persisted, script remained intact/executable, log retained its pre-restart entry, and a manual run successfully appended a new log line
